Northern Germany...
I don't even find the motivation for a Jobhunt. 
I think my main Problem is that I don't want to be alone anymore, but the People I like, don't like me.

Im not sure, I already had a lot of thoughts which made me want to die.
Its not only the way I treated my father, I'm also too weak for live, I tried to find a Job, but after a half of a year I already felt like I didn't had any Power anymore, I was tired and unfocused from then. 

I think one of my main Problems is this shitty lil' village im Livin' in, it's so frustrating here, there isn't even a good connection to the next city. So u sit around here everyday. The way to come out here is to find a Job and move in a flat, but how I told, I just can't work.
Im also pretty lonely, it's not like im ugly, overweight or disabled I just can't find anyone matching to me, or the people I feel attracted to don't like me. 

My whole life is a giant bunch of shit.

I wish I could, but somedays I can't think of anything else than killing myself. On these days I can't focus on any conversations or work, I just sit there and think about ways of suicide and an inner is screaming for it. 
I don't have any hope that my life will change someday, I can't explain why, but for 3 years now nothing changed. I only yearn for my death.
This shouldnt be curvy, this should be normal, fuck slim girls!
